item.title: Unwilling Houdini
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes please

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: the base idea is a humanoid entity that cannot be contained, restricted, or willed to do something in any way shape or form, even if willingly. Without a some form of freak accident causing there “escape” It’s an scp designed by an outside group, as a trap for the foundation. The following is a sample list of attempted form of containment

attempt: result:
Standard police issued handcuffs Handcuffs seemed to be faulty falling off after the slightest movement from the scp
Held down by two armed officers Both suffered from Petit mal seizures simultaneously despite having no history of epilepsy
The tactics used by casinos to make sure the house always wins The scp breaks the banks of multiple Casinos before being accused of fowl play resulting in police trying to arrest him
Subject willing turns himself in and is escorted to local jail cell Door unable to close due to mysterious jam, and when the scp leans against a nearby wall it crumbles backwards causing him to fall out of the cell. Into the alleyway behind it

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: the foundation finds the scp after it unintentionally causes a mass prison break. They take it into custody causing a string of freak accidents and a site-wide containment breach. They soon find that the only way to keep the people safe from the scp is with anti-containment measures. A system of covert actions taken to make sure that the scp is on no way shape or form confined to one area due to another persons actions, this way his anomalous properties are never activated. However this proves far more difficult then they thought

Hook/Attention-Grabber: the main hook is effort needed by the foundation in order to keep the anti-containment measures in place. Because as seen above if the scp gets arrested or walks into the wrong place it can cause all sorts of problems. Meaning that every person staffed on this scp has to be extremely careful wi the there actions. Or they risk the anti-containment failing, the with the fallout scaling with the size and effect of the containment, wether physical or metaphorical.

Additional Notes: this is my first scp in a list designed by an outside force to screw with the foundation, starting small now to test the waters.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn
